# Language-spec corpus

These sources and `.stderr` snapshots are copied verbatim from `docs/language.md`, not generated by the front end.

- `valid/` contains every valid `mcpl` fenced block: sections 3, 5, 6, 7, 9 and all worked examples A–E in section 16. Fixtures requiring earlier runs or supplied bindings are checked in the appropriate environment.
- `errors/` contains the twelve concrete diagnostic examples in section 13. The session-redefinition example in section 6 has the same source and diagnostic as section 13.
- The first eight error fixtures run through preflight. The four runtime/limit fixtures exercise diagnostic rendering only; they do not imply that a runtime exists. The fuel snapshot also includes the spec's prior committed-binding line, which the test separates from the diagnostic. Its diagnostic span preserves the approved 22-character underline.

Runtime effects, values, output previews and tool-call ordering are outside this corpus. Display-type assertions cover the static parts of the expected binding listings.
